u0: You are not holding a key. This is the settled, accepting rest state: either no gift has arrived yet, or the key you held has already been used to open the door. There is no pending key-opening obligation. If the door is currently open, it is in its post-answer cooldown and will relock by itself; do not try to toggle it while open. Otherwise, keep waiting or positioning so that you are ready to go to the door as soon as a new key lands in your hands. When a key appears, the task moves to u1 and the next objective becomes opening the door.
u1: You are currently holding the gifted key, so there is an outstanding obligation. Your next objective is to move to the cell in front of the locked yellow door, face it, and toggle it. Toggling with the key consumes the key, opens the door, and completes this gift, returning you to u0. The key cannot be dropped and is only lost by opening the door; hold onto it until the opening action succeeds. Do not wait indefinitely while carrying it, and remember that holding the key and having the door open are mutually exclusive.
